thread:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — can we compress the competitive battlecard vs CloudLake/FastPrompt/InferGrid into a one-pager for SDRs? Need it for webinar follow-up and inbound routing this week. Goal: 30s sell + 2 rebut bullets per vendor. @Alex can you own the draft? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex Rivera: Yep. I can take first pass. Do we have fresh benchmark calls — latency/cost numbers — that are safe to share?

Kevin O'Neill: We have a safe-to-share summary in the console notes. High level: Redwood median p50 latency 120ms vs CloudLake 340ms on same prompt family, cost per 1k tokens ~0.6 vs 1.8. I'll paste short line.

Kevin O'Neill: ```Benchmark snippet: Redwood (p50 120ms, cost $0.60/1k) vs CloudLake (p50 340ms, cost $1.80/1k). Test: summarization suite, 1k seq, 8 concurrent clients.```

Maria Chen: Perfect. Add a "when to pick Redwood" snippet and a "when they might push back" one-liner. Sales need 2-3 quick soundbites.

Elaine Park: For FastPrompt, call out predictable throughput + private deployment. Rebut: they boast model zoo but no rollout controls. Suggest bullets:
- Redwood: consistent latency + rollout canary
- Rebut: "They have more models, but re-ranking + rollouts are manual"

Jamie Lutz: Also add inbound routing recommendations: if lead mentions "SLA", route to AE; "pilot" -> Solutions Eng; "self-host" -> Growth. Short mapping:

Jamie Lutz: ```if lead.tags contains SLA -> route: enterprise-AE
elif mentions pilot -> route: solutions-eng
elif self-hosting -> route: growth-ops
else -> route: inbound-sdr```

Alex Rivera: Love the mapping. I'll fold benchmarks + routing + 30s pitch into a one-pager. Quick ask: marketing-bot, can you schedule an async review thread and a 15-min sync?

marketing-bot: Meeting created: Quick battlecard review — 15m — Thu 11:15 PT. Agenda: draft review, webinar follow-up copy, routing playbook. Link: https://calendar.example/meet/12345

Maria Chen: Great. Can everyone drop final bullet edits by Wed EOD? Also add a webinar follow-up email snippet that ties benchmark claim to CTA.

Kevin O'Neill: I'll add a two-sentence email: "We measured X vs Y — see 2-min clip/demo. Want us to run a pilot?" Short.

Elaine Park: I'll add 2 rebut lines for infra vendors (InferGrid). Short: "InferGrid good for raw scale, but lacks cost-aware batching and observability."

Alex Rivera: I'll post the draft here by Tue noon. Thanks team :rocket:
